visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoors at night, a woman with long wavy hair wears a white halter top, talking excitedly to the camera. Behind her, a group of three adults stands on a sidewalk next to a stone pillar; one woman laughs heartily. (2) Indoors, a close-up of the woman in the white top standing next to a bald man in a patterned shirt. They are in a well-lit area with reflective walls. (3) The camera follows two adults from behind walking along a night street with greenery and city lights. (4) Fast cuts of a concert stage with bright strobe lights and a male performer in a patterned jacket and hat gesturing on stage. (5) The woman and her friends are seen in a dark, purple-lit indoor space, singing and moving their heads rhythmically. (6) A brightly lit hallway where the woman in the white top and a woman in a black tank top walk towards the camera. (7) A series of shots in a colorful playroom: a young boy with blue paint on his cheeks chews something; a girl with a blue star sticker on her face looks at the camera; another boy growls playfully; a young girl sits near toy water bottles. Several blue-painted art boards are scattered on a floor. (8) An elevator mirror selfie shows the woman, the bald man, and several children. (9) In a modern gym with treadmills, the woman in black athletic wear walks past a mirror. (10) Close-up of the woman on a stationary bike, showing a grimace of physical exertion. (11) The woman and bald man perform lunges and squats with heavy dumbbells in a spacious gym. (12) The bald man leans in to kiss the woman while she sits on the gym floor. (13) Inside a minimalist kitchen, an older woman with short hair and a striped dress prepares food at a counter. The younger woman sits on the floor nearby, looking at her phone. (14) A wide shot of a living room filled with children playing and adults sitting on sofas. Balloons are visible. (15) Back in the kitchen, the older woman talks while gesturing with her hands.
